title: Cartwise Shopper Batches — Pay on Cancellation, Drops, Start Deadlines and Returns to Store
content:
**Cancellation after shopping started.** When every order of a Cartwise Shopper Batches batch is canceled after shopping started, the shopper is paid a cancellation pay component: the batch type's cancellation pay plus the batch type's additional pay per item unit multiplied by the item units already shopped, as recorded on the cancellation, the total rounded to the cent. A batch canceled before shopping started earns nothing.

**Drops.** A dropped batch earns nothing, because a drop forfeits the pay, whatever was already shopped. A drop whose reason is the shopper's own choice records a batch-dropped violation on the shopper contractor account; a drop whose reason is one of the batch type's excused drop reasons records none.

**Start deadline.** Shopping must start within the batch type's start window, counted from the acceptance time; otherwise the batch is released as dropped with the reason "not started".

**Returns to store.** An order returned to the store earns the batch type's return-to-store pay only after the batch type's required number of customer contact attempts and its required minutes of waiting at the door have been recorded in the app.

**Which batches can be dropped or canceled.** Only a batch that is accepted or shopping can be dropped or canceled, as shown by its status in the system record.

## At a glance

| What happened | Pay |
|---|---|
| All orders canceled before shopping started | Nothing |
| All orders canceled after shopping started | Cancellation pay plus the per-unit amount for units already shopped |
| Batch dropped (any reason, any stage) | Nothing |
| Order returned after the required attempts and wait, recorded in the app | Return-to-store pay for that order |

| Drop reason | Violation recorded on the contractor account |
|---|---|
| Shopper's own choice | A batch-dropped violation |
| An excused reason (store closed, app outage, vehicle breakdown, personal safety) | None |

## Worked illustration (hypothetical figures)

A hypothetical batch type pays 5.00 cancellation pay and 0.10 per unit already shopped. Its batch is canceled mid-shop with 23 units shopped: 5.00 plus 23 multiplied by 0.10 (2.30) gives 7.30. Had the same batch been dropped by the shopper with 23 units shopped, it would earn nothing.
